lines.en: It’s time to get gamey, but not like the meat! Four orbs of power make mission complete!
Do you have what it takes to defeat the [[insert generic antagonist]? Test your skills in the Shiawase Group’s latest RPG-
Please be advised that Sensei-Quest is still in early access and all assets and aspects are subject to change.
: Is the main antagonist a pizza?
No. We just liked how the icon looked. It really fit the vibe we were going for. We might change it later.
: What is it with games and releasing in early access these days? Why can’t you just finish them first?
Because we need your money! Now run along and collect PREMIUM CURRENCY if you want to get to the end of the game!
There will be an option to buy this later. But you’re a beta-tester right now, so we’ve added PREMIUM CURRENCY as a drop from every standard enemy in the game.
: But how am I supposed to defeat enemies if I don’t have any gear?
Oh! We took care of that as well!
: Was that last one really necessary?
What’s wrong? DEPRESSION is a very powerful skill you can use to debuff your enemies by making them feel bad for you!
Or at least that's what it will be. Right now, it doesn't do anything.
: I wanna learn how to cast FIRE BALL.
Then you better get out there and start earning PREMIUM CURRENCY!
Oh, look! Here comes the tutorial NPC now!
: What’s that dripping out of your helmet, though?
: That is very interesting! Are you ready to learn how to play Sensei-Quest?
: Do I even have a choice?
: Not if you ever want to see your family again!
: The objective of Sensei-Quest is to track down the Four Elemental Orbs of Power and combine them into an Ancient Orb in order to summon the final boss!
: Earth, Wind, Water, Fire. Got it.
: You said they’re elemental orbs, didn’t you?
: Yes, but not those elements. The elemental orbs you need to collect are, Plant, Worm, Fist, and Red.
: None of those things are elements.
: Not with that attitude, they’re not!
: Oh! Also, my name is Meowri! I probably should have told you that earlier.
: It’s fine. You look kind of familiar, though.
: That isn’t very surprising! My design is based on the [[IDEAL FEMALE], so of course you’d remember if you ever encountered anyone who looks like me. But that’s not important right now!
: Sensei-Quest is an [[OPEN WORLD RPG], so you are free to explore wherever you like! We’re in the town of Fuckladore right now, which is the main hub of the game.
: Fuckladore is full of vendors and taverns! Or...will be full of vendors and taverns! Right now, there is only one of each.
: Yeah, sorry about that. You can still feel free to browse those at your leisure, though!
: The MERCHANT sells weapons and armor you can use to better take down your enemies, while the TAVERN sells powerful spells and abilities you can use to...also take down your enemies.
: Why does the tavern sell spells? Isn’t that supposed to be the kind of place that I pick up quests from or something like that?
: Is it? None of our developers have ever played a video game before. We’re all just kind of guessing.
: This is sounding less fun by the second.
: Just wait until you find out the combat mechanics lack any amount of depth and use the same text box system as visual novels!
: The game is super grindy too!
: Can I just exit out of your dialogue and go exploring now? I clearly have a lot of work to do.
: Okay! If you want to explore on your own, I’ll let you.
: Just come find me once you’ve collected all of the Orbs of Power and I’ll help you summon the final boss.
: Cool. Thanks, Meowri. I can’t wait to unlock the first sex scene.
: There aren’t any sex scenes in Sensei-Quest.
Meowri has returned to MEOWRI’S HOUSE.
It’s time for you to save the world!
: I will be the hero this world needs.
: But where should I begin my adventure?
This is the point of no return. Do you still wish to proceed?
: Wow, an actual helpful tip for once.
Do you wish to proceed or not?
: I have a few loose ends to tie up first...
: Hey there! Welcome to the Traveler’s Tavern.
: I haven’t seen you around here before. Are you new in town?
: Yeah. I just woke up here and now I need to collect a bunch of orbs or I will never see my family again. How is your day?
: Well, actually I can since none of the assets for my tavern have been added into Sensei-Quest yet and I’m kind of just standing around in an empty room waiting for an update.
: But I’ve got items! And quests!
: But the tutorial said you didn’t have quests and that you only sold abilities.
: Outdated tooltip, I guess. But it’s not like those things are ever helpful in the first place, right?
: Can I have Fire Ball for free please?
: Nope! But I’d be willing to let it go for only 500 PREMIUM CURRENCY.
: That’s the same exact price written on the board. I’m not getting a discount at all.
: No discounts here, buddy. A girl’s gotta make a living after all.
: Ughhhh this game is so user unfriendly. I hate having to work for things.

: Same here, man. You think I want to be spending all of my time just standing around like this? Heck no. I ain’t built for the NPC life. So just tell me what you want or drag your butt on outta here. Capiche?
: What can I get for you?
Right now, I have [pcur] PREMIUM CURRENCY.
What do I want to buy?
: Rumor has it that some big ole’ douchebag is holed up in the Sea of Stairs. And if my intel is correct, he might have one of those orbs you’re looking for.
: How possible is it that your intel is incorrect?
: Did you just sell me a quest that only has a 50%% chance of giving me a reward?
: Yup! And there’s nothing you can do about it either since all sales are final.
: I would like to speak to the manager.
: That’ll cost you another 5000 PREMIUM CURRENCY.
: Yes. Why do you hate me?
: I never hate the player. I hate the game.
: Get it? Because we’re in a game right now.
: I think I'll just try my luck without speaking to the manager.
: One of my other customers just came in and told me something about an ancient being taking shelter somewhere in Bedlehem.
: I didn’t realize you had other customers.
: Of course I have other customers. What would the point of a beta test be if only one person was testing the game?
: I’m not sure. How do I get to Bedlehem, though? I’ve never been there before.
: Not many people have. It’s a super secret location that only a handful of us know how to reach. But seeing as you’ve purchased the quest, I guess I kind of have to tell you, don’t I?
: That would be greatly appreciated. I have a good feeling I’ll be able to find one of the elemental orbs there.
: Maybe! Only one way to find out, buddy!
You’re not sure how, but without any actual dialogue revealing the details of the location, you suddenly know how to get to Bedlehem!
Quest accepted — Palace of the Fist!
: There’s this place not far from here where all of the strongest adventurers go to train called the Palace of the Fist.
: And right now, the master of the palace is offering an orb of power to anyone who is able to defeat him.
: Taking him down will be no easy task, though. And even if you have the right build, you might have to try a bunch of different methods until something works.
: If that is the price that must be paid for reuniting with my family, I will do it. I will bring this palace master to his knees.
: Go for it, Sensei! I believe in you!
: I will put my wiener is his stupid mouth too.
: Then I’ll wiggle it around and tell him to call me “daddy.”
: You’re being really weird about this, man.
: He better be ready for my cummy-wummies.
: Okay, I’m gonna have to ask you to leave now.
You got kicked out of the store!
: That guy will never know what hit him once the penis comes out.
: I’m sure I don’t have to tell you this, but the Unholy Cathedral is the most dangerous place east of Fucklador.
: What’s the most dangerous place to the west?
: Please tell me there isn’t an orb there.
: There might be! But yeah, for your sake, I hope there’s not.
: But anyway! If you want to try your luck against the Red Twins, I’d head over there. It won’t be an easy fight, though. Most of my customers try to stay clear of that place by any means possible.
: What happens to the ones who don’t?
: Well, I wouldn’t still be selling this quest if any of them completed it, would I?
: Good point. Guess I’ll go see if I can take them down then.
: Okay! Just try not to die. I kind of need you to stay alive for reasons.
: You’ll find out in the sequel.
Sensei has obtained the first piece of an ancient map!
: Hell yeah. Now I can finally go treasure hunting.
: What am I supposed to do with this?
: Beats me. I just figured I could make a quick dime off of it.
I should try and find the rest of the map...
: What is this? This is not sex.
: Of course it’s not sex. Did you seriously think you were going to be able to just buy your way into my pants?
: The tutorial straight up told you there wasn’t any sex in this game. What the hell were you thinking? How long did you have to grind to even get this much PREMIUM CURRENCY?
: A long time. I am so tired. Please give sex now.
: Not that kind of girl, pal. But that coupon will get you 10%% off at Tojo Ramen once you get out of here!
: I’d rather take 10%% of your clothes off.
: Do you...want my tie as a consolation prize?
: Can I have your underwear instead?
: Please get out of my store.
You got kicked out of the store!
: Hey there, nyaa! Welcome to the shop, nyaa! First time in, nyaa?
: Are you going to do that at the end of every sentence?
: Would you like me to stop, nyaa?
: Praise the lord. If I had to do that one more time, I was probably going to claw my eyes out. So thanks to you, I won’t go blind!
: As the hero who will save the world, I am happy to be of service. Now tell me, merchant — what is it you sell here?
: Can you not read the graphic to my left? Did the developers forget to code it in or something?
: I can read it. I just wasn’t sure if that would be meta-gaming or if you had to verbally tell me before I could conceive those words in-universe.
: Nope. Just look at the board, tell me what you want, then fork over the dough.
: Why is everything so expensive here?
: Or complain too. That’s fine, I guess.
: You’re charging 800 PREMIUM CURRENCY for a bucket.
: It’s a good bucket. What do you want from me?
: For what? What do you even need that for?
: I have no idea. I just got here. Everything is so fresh and new to me.

: Well, it’ll all make sense in due time why my prices seem a little high. But even if it doesn’t, I don’t have any competition! And if you’re going to advance, you’re going to have to buy this stuff sooner or later.
: We’ll see about that, roadside merchant.
: So! Anything tickle your fancy right now? Or do you want to shop around for a bit? And by “a bit” I mean forever. Because, again, I’m the only girl with wares like these.
: What can I get for you?
Right now, I have [pcur] PREMIUM CURRENCY.
What do I want to buy?
Sensei has obtained the Sword of Hope!
Sensei has obtained the Shield of Resistance!
Sensei has obtained the Boots of Forgiveness!
Sensei has obtained a Steel Bucket!
: Not so high and mighty now, are you?
: I can’t believe I just paid 800 PREMIUM CURRENCY for a bucket.
: I can. It’s called capitalism, buddy. Supply and demand. There are no other buckets in Fucklador.
: Well, at least now you’ve got a bucket to catch some of it!
Sensei has obtained some Massage Oil!
Sensei has obtained the second piece of an ancient map!
: Hell yeah. Now I can finally go treasure hunting.
: What am I supposed to do with this?
: Beats me. I just figured I could make a quick dime off of it.
I should try and find the rest of the map...
A new profile outfit for Kaori has been unlocked!
A new profile outfit for Nao-chan has been unlocked!
: Is there a problem, dear customer?
: I think there might be a printing error on your menu. This is not what I attempted to purchase.
I hold the stick out so she can see that it’s a stick and not sex.
: That seems like a quality piece of wood to me! May I ask what you were attempting to buy?
: Well, how am I supposed to help if I don’t know what the error is?
: Can’t you just look at my receipt?
: Then no, I can’t help you.
: But if you’re looking to sell that neat stick you’ve got there, I can give you...10 PREMIUM CURRENCY for it!
: Fine. I’ll give you 15. But that’s my final offer.
The Fields of Despair sprawl out for miles before you! Just look at how sad everything is!
: This doesn’t look sad at all.
Nuh-uh. There’s some other stuff too. Just look at that guy in the suit back there. And- oh! I see a snail!
: I guess that guy back there does look kind of sad now that you mention it.
Told you! But anyway! The Fields of Despair are where you can grind for PREMIUM CURRENCY!
Each monster has its own weakness and monetary value!
In the final version of the game, these monsters will drop SUBPREMIUM CURRENCY which can be exchanged for PREMIUM CURRENCY at an exchange rate of 2:1 or RAINBOW COINS at 4:1!
SUBPREMIUM CURRENCY can also be purchased with real money.
: Hold on, what the fuck are RAINBOW COINS?
A higher tier of PREMIUM CURRENCY that can be purchased in special bundles with RAINBOW QUARTZ!
But we love you! And we definitely mean you! Not just your wallet!
Now, go! Grind! Earn your PREMIUM CURRENCY!
Looks like I’m back here again...
You approach the man wearing a suit. His name is Kenji. He does not belong here.
He gazes out at the mountains, thinking back to the days when he would visit his grandparents in the countryside of Gifu. It all seems so distant now.
Kenji had been off the clock for several hours but, for some reason, he decided to stop here today instead of returning to his wife.
They had been fighting lately. Their marriage hadn’t been the same since he’d learned of her affair. But Kenji was spineless and couldn’t find the words to say to try and mend the rift.
His eyes hone in on a cardinal — his daughter’s favorite bird. She had passed away from a lengthy battle with leukemia just a few years ago. He visited her grave every Wednesday.
: Why is there so much background information on this enemy mob?
Kenji’s favorite number was nine. When he was younger, he had dreams of becoming a figure skater. But it was a dream that would be shattered along with his kneecap senior year of high school.
He daydreams of the river — of dipping his toes in and feeling like a child again. And he remembers the games he would play with his brothers as the water washed over their feet.
He hadn’t seen any of them in years now either, but it wasn’t as if his relationship with them was strained. He was just never good at facing the past — and that’s all they were now.
: Why must we fight at all?
: Oh, god. You gave him voice lines?
: No matter how many times I fall, I’ll come right back. I think it’s...some kind of metaphor.
: Tell me, young man...what do you believe the meaning of life is?
: Are we put here to find happiness? Or are we only here to die?

: Maybe there’s no reason at all now that I think about it. Maybe this is all just the result of some fortunate coincidence. And maybe these experiences and lives we lead will be just as fleeting as our fading youth.
: You seek the Four Orbs of Power, don’t you?
: Ha...I remember when I set off on my journey as well.
: I’d just registered at the Adventurer’s Guild...my eyes were still so bright and full of hope back then.
: But now, I don’t even have eyes.
: My...time surely does fly, doesn’t it?
: Tell me...when you find the Four Orbs of Power...what do you intend to do? And if your answer is “find my family” or anything along those lines, let me reassure you...they’re safe and sound.
: They were never in any danger at all. That’s just a lie the game masters tell us to push us forward. To buy more PREMIUM CURRENCY out of fear that they’ll be harmed. But it’s all just manipulation.
: We exist to line their pockets...they don’t even think of us as human.
: But you’re different...you still have a chance. You can be the one to break us out of this cycle.
: So...what do you say, young man? Do you have what it takes to save us?
: Where will your journey lead you from here?
Kenji plunges down the cliff! His body collides with jagged rocks along the way and you can see them tear him open in various places.
Countless memories topple down with him. Visions of his daughter. Conversations at the dinner table with his wife. Family dinners. Soccer games. It’s all gone now. And it’s all your fault.
You also don’t collect any PREMIUM CURRENCY as you would need to climb to the bottom of the cliff to loot his body.
: Guess I’ll just keep grinding then...

: I’ll surely defeat you this time, former friend.
: Listen man, since we used to be on good terms, why don’t I just let you in on a little hint about what will happen if you miraculously do manage to kick my ass.
: Nothing’s going to get any better. Even if you collect the Four Orbs of Power, using them to summon the final boss just sets you up for an even worse death.
: But I know I will win, Manfred.
: Don’t call me that. And how do you know you’ll win?
: THIS GAME IS NAMED AFTER ME!
: Manny? What are you doing here? And who programmed my bedroom into Sensei-Quest?
: You’ve been gone a long time, Sensei. Many things have happened. And I am the ruler of this realm now.
: I’ve been fucking your girlfriend too.
: Wait, how many do you have?
: I don’t know, man. I’ve lost count.
: Well, I’m talking about the rubber one with that hole in it that you keep on the top shelf.
: Oh, so like none of the human girls?
